Citation: Almeida, P., Oliveira, L. S., Silva Jr, E., Britto Jr, A., Koerich, A. PKLot - A robust dataset for parking lot classification. Expert Systems with Applications, 42(11):4937-4949, 2015.
SplitRule: Per camera, days sorted by name: first 0.6 train, next 0.2 validation, rest test. Held-out cameras: first 0.2 setup, rest test.
ReferenceRule: Per view, among fully labeled all-vacant frames from non-test days, the frame whose mean brightness is closest to the median of that view's non-test frames.
